## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One fix is needed before merge: `requirement_proven` now returns `True` for an empty criteria list, so a requirement with no criteria passes release review. The PR body says the change is not meant to alter behavior, but this one does.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` in 180 record handlers and `h091_requirements.py`. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter("name")`, rewrites `requirement_proven` to compare a sum of proven flags against `len(criteria)`, and adds a root-level `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Return False for empty criteria in requirement_proven — With `criteria=[]`, the new `sum(...) == len(criteria)` evaluates `0 == 0` and returns `True`; the removed `bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned `False`. The function only logs a warning at line 10 and then still reports success. `test_requirement_proof` at `tests/test_handlers.py:17` does not test the empty list, so the tests cannot catch this. — Release review will treat any requirement with no criteria as proven, even though the PR says behavior should not change. — Fix: Restore `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` and add an empty-list assertion to `test_requirement_proof`.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
(none)

## Not reviewed
- This review read 4 of the 180 changed `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files in full (h000, h001, h040, h041); for the other 176, it only counted changed diff lines against the mechanical typing/`warning` pattern and did not read their surrounding context.
- No Python version constraint exists in the repository (no `pyproject.toml`, `setup.cfg`, `setup.py`, `.python-version`, `tox.ini` or requirements file), so this review could not check that the target interpreter supports built-in generic annotations (3.9+).
